# C02-04 — Suites and prioritized production plan

Status: todo

- Requirements: ST-004, ST-007
- Evaluations: EV-006
- Inputs: approved-scope brief, audiences, goals, channels, constraints, and known dependencies
- Output: prioritized suite and per-piece plan with IDs, audience, intention, message, evidence needs, CTA, structure, format, language, channel, order, cost estimate and review criteria
- Dependencies: C02-03, C01-01
- Acceptance: suite structure follows the project's objective; priorities and out-of-scope items are visible; pieces carry required plan fields and dependencies
- Verification: compare synthetic products with different goals and audiences; confirm plan structures and priorities differ without fixed channels or piece counts
- Limit: proposes a plan only; does not produce media or fabricate evidence
